functions.name: list-historical-report-links
functions.description: List the access relations currently exposed for a historical Contact Center report, such as status, JSON data and download.

reportId.description: Opaque historical report identifier from a creation response.

FunctionInput_8x8_listhistoricalreportli.description: Identifies the historical Contact Center report whose access relations to retrieve.

url.description: Provider access URL; do not assume anonymous access, a signed link or any fixed expiry.

relation.description: Provider relation name, for example status, data or download.

items.description: One access relation exposed by the provider for this report.
Access relations actually returned by the provider, in provider order.

FunctionOutput_8x8_listhistoricalreportl.description: The complete collection of currently exposed report access relations.

region.description: Contact Center tenant region; omitted or null uses the US base path.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier for X-Tenant-Info; required for multitenant customers.

tags.instructions: Use the report identifier returned by report creation. This is useful for an application that needs native access relations; it does not download a file or grant public access. For report contents use `list-historical-report-rows` or `download-historical-report`; for generation state use `get-historical-report-status`. Do not assume Script Paths has a data relation.

functions.name: list-historical-report-rows
functions.description: Read one page of generated historical Contact Center report rows, preserving metric labels and subtotal metadata. The JSON dataset is capped at 10,000 records and excludes Script Paths.

limit.description: Maximum rows in this page; use the same limit when continuing with a cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from a prior page for this same report, tenant and limit. Omit for the first page.

reportId.description: Opaque identifier of the generated historical report.

FunctionInput_8x8_listhistoricalreportro.description: Read one page of an already generated historical Contact Center report.

label.description: Human-friendly label, omitted when the provider supplies only a key-value map.

value.description: Scalar dimension or metric value, preserving its provider type; null can indicate a dimension summarized across values. Generic cells are not automatically interpreted as timestamps or durations.

items.description: One provider dimension or metric cell.

cells.description: Dimension and metric cells, retaining provider order when available.

total.description: Provider subtotal/grand-total descriptor; null or omitted when the row has no descriptor.

type.description: Provider total classification, such as subtotal or grandtotal.

endIndex.description: Provider index of the end of the summarized range; preserved without reinterpretation, including null.

startIndex.description: Provider index of the start of the summarized range; preserved without reinterpretation, including null.

items.description: One provider report row, including its total descriptor when supplied.
Rows in this provider page, including any total rows.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for the next provider JSON page; omitted when no next relation is returned. Exhaustion is subject to the 10,000-record cap.

FunctionOutput_8x8_listhistoricalreportr.description: One JSON report page, preserving scalar cells and subtotal metadata without claiming a complete export.

region.description: Contact Center tenant region; omitted or null uses the United States routing.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier for X-Tenant-Info; required by 8x8 for multitenant accounts.

tags.instructions: First check `get-historical-report-status` for DONE. Use the identifier from report creation. This returns one page, with limit 1–1000, default 100. Pass nextCursor as cursor with the same report and limit for the next page. JSON stops at the provider's 10,000-record cap, so exhausted pagination is not proof the full report has fewer records. Use `download-historical-report` for the complete file or for Script Paths.

functions.name: list-objects
functions.description: List one page of us-west storage object metadata, with structured filters and sorting.

limit.description: Maximum metadata records in this page; unchanged on continuation.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation bound to exact query.

sortBy.description: Object or tag field for sorting; omission uses provider ordering.

states.description: Lifecycle states to include; explicitly defaults to AVAILABLE.

filters.description: Additional AND-combined criteria; omitted or empty adds none.

field.description: Object field or tag key, such as id, type, objectName or callerId. Use states for objectState.

values.description: Ordinary values; tag units remain source-specific. createdTime/updatedTime operands use explicit-offset RFC3339 with at most millisecond precision.

operator.description: Comparison; scalar operators require exactly one value.

sortDirection.description: Sorting direction; omission uses provider default.

FunctionInput_8x8_listobjects.description: One page of us-west storage metadata selected with structured criteria.

tags.description: Source-specific metadata tags preserving duplicates and source units.

value.description: Tag text; units and meaning depend on object type and key.

type.description: Source object type including callrecording, callcenterrecording, screenrecording or meeting.

state.description: Provider lifecycle state; only AVAILABLE content can be downloaded.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC only when its timezone can be established.

sizeBytes.description: Exact stored byte count as decimal text, avoiding numeric precision loss.

updatedAt.description: Update instant in UTC only when source units and timezone can be established.

nextCursor.description: Continuation omitted when lastPage is true.

FunctionOutput_8x8_listobjects.description: One storage metadata page and an optional query-bound continuation.

tags.instructions: Use to find object IDs for restore, deletion or ZIP preparation. Default state selection is AVAILABLE; include archived states to find cold-storage objects. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and unchanged query/limit. Limit 1–100, default 100; this endpoint addresses us-west.

functions.name: restore-object
functions.description: Request a temporary downloadable copy of an archived us-west object. Returns acceptance, not completed restoration; storage edit access is required.

objectId.description: ID of the archived us-west object.

expirationDays.description: Days the restored copy is retained before removal.

FunctionInput_8x8_restoreobject.description: Archived us-west object and optional restored-copy retention.

accepted.description: Restore request was accepted, not a claim that content is ready.

objectId.description: Archived object targeted by the accepted request.

FunctionOutput_8x8_restoreobject.description: Acceptance of an asynchronous restore request, not restoration completion.

tags.instructions: Find an ARCHIVED object with `list-objects`, then request restoration. The copy may take up to 24 hours to become AVAILABLE and lasts 1–10 days, default 7. Check `list-objects` later; do not wait or repeatedly issue restore requests. This does not recover deleted objects.
